# InteractionShowcaseBuilder

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Samples` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/Samples/InteractionShowcaseBuilder.cs#L28)

Builds the interaction showcase scene: one labelled station per feature of the module, laid out
around the player.

Built from code rather than checked in as YAML alone, so that it can be rebuilt after a
settings change and read as a list of what the module offers. The scene it produces is
checked in beside it, and a rebuild asks before overwriting.

Hand poses are left to the auto-pose solver. Authoring a pose is a workflow rather than scene
content - it wants the pose window and a hand to shape - so the stations that would use one
say so on their sign instead.

### Populate() {#populate}

Builds every station into whatever scene is already open, and saves nothing.

Separate from [`Build()`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-samples/InteractionShowcaseBuilder#build) so the scene handling and the content are not the same
decision: this is what a script driving the editor calls, and what a test would call.
